subject: SF - Physical AI Mixer - 23rd Sept
text:
Hi [NAME],

Noticed your team uses Foxglove for robotics data visualization, wondering
if you're planning to be at Actuate [YEAR]
<[LINK]>
later
this month? We're hosting a Physical AI Mixer in conjunction & we'd love to
extend an invite.

It'll be on the evening of 23rd Sept at Ebb & Flow (4 mins walk from the
main conference) with Physical AI leaders joining from Physical
Intelligence, Zipline, Dyna Robotics and more (capping attendance at 40).

In case Encord is new to you - we support leading Physical AI teams (e.g.
Boston Dynamics, Skydio & Carbon Robotics) automate their annotation
pipelines at scale + unify image, video and point cloud data development in
one place, often as a complement to Foxglove.

Will gladly extend an invite if you're available - let me know!

subject: Visual quality eval pipelines
text:
Hi [NAME]

Congrats on your Series A announcement! Seems like generating accurate
camera motion styles is a key focus for your team - so I thought it might
be worth reconnecting on model output evaluations.

In case Encord is new to you - We support Synthesia, Captions and
TwelveLabs on RLHF and visual quality evaluation projects. We help teams
improve efficiency with end-to-end tooling for captioning, evaluating and
reviewing human feedback consistency on complex eval projects. We've also
expanded our analytics layer to make workforce productivity metrics more
transparent.
